items.title: Ross Simmonds: AEO and GEO are distinct from traditional SEO in AI era
items.summary: In a podcast with Mike King, Ross Simmonds argues that AEO and GEO go beyond site-focused SEO, emphasizing consensus across Reddit, YouTube, PR, and more via retrieval augmented generation. Brands risk irrelevance if they dismiss AI discovery as covered by SEO alone. The discussion urges mapping synthetic queries and building content ecosystems to win in AI search.

items.title: Scott: Traditional SEO is dead as 93% of AI searches end zero-click
items.summary: Scott declares SEO obsolete with 93% of AI search sessions yielding no website visits, highlighting stats like AI Overviews in 25% of searches and citation confidence replacing page rank. Marketers must shift to GEO and AEO with structured, quotable content under 40 words per block. Adaptation is key as brands compete to be cited in AI answers.

items.title: Gazi Masud: Rise of GEO amid the 'Great Decoupling' in search
items.summary: Gazi Masud details the end of traditional SEO as AI like Google Overviews answers directly, causing impressions to rise but clicks to drop 4x. GEO optimizes for AI citations using structured content, E-E-A-T, and proprietary data across platforms like TikTok and Reddit. He shares a 2026 checklist prioritizing AI citations over keywords.

items.title: Rewriting Classic Authors Like Roald Dahl Breaks Trust in Literature
items.summary: Rawle Nyanzi criticizes publishers for rewriting works by authors such as Roald Dahl, Ian Fleming, and Ursula K. Le Guin to align with modern sensibilities. He argues this practice erodes trust and should cease for any type of literature, from pop novels to canonical works. The post sparked significant engagement and replies highlighting dangers to original author intent.

items.title: AI Storybooks Scrape Human Authors' Work Without Permission During National Storytelling Week
items.summary: Author Julie Bertagna accuses AI-generated children's storybooks of scraping real authors' works without permission or compensation. She urges @EducationScot to reconsider promoting such content amid #NationalStorytellingWeek, warning of the erasure of human authors. The post highlights ongoing AI controversies in publishing.

items.title: Japanese Author Inserts Strict Ban on AI Training in Her New Commercial Book
items.summary: Manga artist Takakura Tomoko reveals her recently published commercial book includes a clause prohibiting unauthorized use for generative AI training. This move underscores growing author resistance to AI exploitation in the publishing industry. The announcement garnered high likes and reposts.

items.title: Publisher Cancels Buzzy Horror Novel 'Shy Girl' Over AI Generation Allegations
items.summary: Hachette has canceled the upcoming horror novel 'Shy Girl' by Mia Ballard following claims it was largely AI-written, with detection tools identifying 78% AI content. The incident exposes vulnerabilities in publishing's AI oversight and lack of regulation. Industry debates intensify on vetting processes and AI's role in fiction.

items.title: Seoul International Book Fair Tackles AI's Impact on Writers and Readers
items.summary: The Seoul International Book Fair discusses how AI is transforming publishing, coinciding with the 10th anniversary of AlphaGo's victory over Lee Se-dol. Panels question ethical use of AI writing tools and generation of content. Publishers and authors explore adaptation strategies amid rapid tech advances.

items.title: AI Flooding Agents and Publishers with Generated Books Sparks Industry Debate
items.summary: A surge of AI-generated books is overwhelming literary agents and publishers, prompting discussions on detection and response. Content creators note this isn't justification for harsh reviews but highlights challenges in distinguishing human work. The trend fuels broader concerns over AI's infiltration in self-publishing and traditional channels.

items.title: Variety Slammed Over Opinion Piece on Chuck Norris' Legacy
items.summary: Variety faced significant backlash from conservatives after publishing an opinion piece claiming Chuck Norris' political views overshadow his film legacy. The article sparked heated debates on social media about separating entertainment from politics. Critics accused the publication of politicizing Hollywood icons.

items.title: Jimmy Kimmel Draws Backlash for Oscars Joke Targeting CBS and North Korea
items.summary: Host Jimmy Kimmel sparked controversy with a joke at the Oscars jabbing CBS and North Korea, leading to viewer backlash. The remark was seen by some as echoing familiar political targets amid heightened sensitivities. The incident underscores challenges in comedy during major award shows.

items.title: 'KPop Demon Hunters' Ignites Christian Backlash Over Demonic Themes
items.summary: The animated series 'KPop Demon Hunters' has provoked strong reactions from Christian communities due to its portrayal of spiritual battles and demonic elements. Discussions highlight a divide between pop culture trends and religious values. The controversy emerged around March 13.

items.title: Woke Films Hype Fails to Deliver Box Office as Pattern Continues
items.summary: Reviewer Possum Reviews highlights how woke-pandering projects like The Marvels, Ghostbusters (2016), Birds of Prey, The Bride, and 1348 Ex Voto get hyped by virtue-signalers but flop financially. This long-term trend warns brands against niche pandering. The post from March 13 garnered thousands of likes.

items.title: Audiences Rebel Against Woke Hollywood After Gervais' Oscars Wake-Up
items.summary: A user laments Hollywood's decline into wokeness and hypocrisy, crediting Ricky Gervais' past Oscars rant as a pivotal moment. Many report boycotting awards shows and glamorous events in response. Posted on March 16 amid ongoing industry critiques.

items.title: 'The Boys' Recent Season Overwhelmed by Excessive Woke Elements
items.summary: A fan abandons the latest season of 'The Boys' after one or two episodes due to overload of woke content, despite prior love for the show. References Bill Maher's recent commentary on Hollywood's extremes. Discussion posted March 18.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Survey Reveals Small Businesses Embrace AI but Struggle with Integration
items.summary: A Goldman Sachs survey shows over three-quarters of small businesses are using AI to some degree, with more than 90% reporting it works, yet only 14% have fully integrated it across core operations due to challenges like technical expertise and data privacy. Efficiency gains are prominent, but fewer than one in four use AI for revenue tasks like supply chain optimization, and nearly seven in ten expect revenue growth. Over 70% need more training to maximize benefits.

items.title: 10 Best AI Tools for Business in 2026 to Boost Productivity
items.summary: The article highlights top AI tools like Jasper AI for content, Salesforce Einstein for customer intelligence, and UiPath for automation, enabling small businesses to cut costs, automate tasks, and achieve quick ROI without heavy technical skills. Tools now affordable at $99/month help shift focus to strategic work, with examples like a manufacturing firm saving $2.3M via DataRobot and a SaaS boosting sales close rate to 31%. These plug-and-play solutions are transforming operations for SMBs.

items.title: Agentic AI: The Next Shift Beyond Tools for Autonomous Business Workflows
items.summary: Agentic AI evolves from generative models to systems that plan, decide, act, and self-improve, powering multi-agent collaboration, tool use, and end-to-end automation in areas like marketing, customer ops, and data analysis. Unlike basic AI that answers or generates, agentic AI handles entire processes autonomously with memory and feedback loops. This promises to revolutionize small businesses by enabling workflow automation without constant oversight.

items.title: Automatic.co Launches Full Agentic Automation Platform for SMBs
items.summary: Automatic.co has just launched a comprehensive agentic AI platform designed specifically for small and medium-sized businesses, coinciding with major deployments like BNY Mellon's 20,000 AI agents. This move underscores the urgent opportunity for SMB owners to automate operations now amid rapid AI advancements. The platform aims to deliver scalable efficiency, positioning it as a key player in business AI transformation.
